notes.title: Release patch #1! Bullet sponge enemies must be gone & more!
notes.content:
Hey!
Release patch #1 is live!

Changes:
[list]
[*] Added button to sell all junk items to merchant
[*] Fixed NPCs hp (no more bullet sponge enemies)
[*] Fixed jerky AI movement
[*] Fixed AIs like if they all are snipers 
[*] Fixed AI shooting distance (now it depends on weapon)
[*] Fixed player spawn on random encounter levels
[*] Descreased food, water and energy needs
[*] Fixed exit from Bunker to Cave
[*] Stacked water up to 10 items
[*] Fixed grenade throwing range
[*] Fixed vest prices
[*] Fixed localization
[/list]

Devs

notes.title: Beta Update #6. 2 days until release!
notes.content:
Beta Update #6 is live on Steam!
[list]
[*] Added more than 10 Steam achievements. Yay!
[*] Added possibility to jump with shield
[*] Added interaction hint “Press KEY to kick” when enemy is close and player is aiming at him
[*] Added tutorial on prosthesis pickup
[*] Added HUD icons for dead NPC on random encounter levels on global map
[*] Added Assault Rifle on start level
[*] Made weapon/shield shortcut cell in HUD red if corresponding is broken
[*] Moved Prolog to Journal tab
[*] Replaced NPC heads. More than 10 unique new heads!
[*] Replaced Shuffle backpack inventory (top right corner)
[*] Replaced “Other” item category with “Junk”
[*] Replaced game icon in taskbar
[*] Replaced Stopper’s head
[*] Fixed Mukesh dialogue when Slaves are dead
[*] Fixed localization
[*] Removed NPC as partner functionality. Hernia won’t be your partner anymore
[/list]

MOST IMPORTANTLY:
[olist]
[*] This update could break old game saves. We warned about that :)
[*] It is highly recommended to start a new game now if you have issues with old game saves (please restart the game first if you tried to load old game save).
[*] You have to start new game if you want to get Steam achievements while playing the game.
[/olist]

Devs

notes.title: Beta Update #5
notes.content:
Hey, survivors. Less than 2 weeks left before POSTWORLD full release on Steam. Yes, no Early Access, you read this right.

Meanwhile, Beta update #5 is ready! Changes:
[list]
[*] Added better UI icons for navigation in the world (green flags for quest objects, yellow icons for merchants, etc.)
[*] Added death cause to death screen (flies, fire, bullets, melee damage, bleeding, etc.)
[*] Added notification when character is thirsty and trying to sleep
[*] Added Hernia to compass
[*] Added more water, food and repair kits to merchants
[*] Added pistol sight and magazine on start level
[*] Replaced heads for Kalym, Mukesh, Oldman and more!
[*] Made character transparent when camera is too close
[*] Last selected quest in journal will be saved
[*] Improved Hernia AI
[*] Fixed first aid kit and surgical kit tooltips when “Medic” skill is acquired
[*] Fixed weird shield behaviour when NPC is stunned by kick
[*] Fixed ladders material
[*] Fixed backpack/vest swap corner case
[*] Fixed tooltip for prostheses slots
[*] Fixed autosaves count and logic (now autosaves use only 5 slots in total, last autosave override the oldest autosave)
[*] Fixed modification time of any game save 
[*] Fixed duration of “Not enough space” notification
[*] Fixed wrong behaviour of “No backpack” label
[*] Fixed tooltips for resolutions different to 1920x1080
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149934/ca3427490ddd38e048915b3dcf2c0b512525aad4.jpg[/img]

Where is Mukesh, stranger?
Kalym
